claim_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.
metric_name: Fatalities from health and safety incidents
context_text: We use this ‘safety guarantee’ to instil a belief that everyone can go home safe and well.；Tragically, we experienced a fatality within our business this year.；Health and safety performance FY25: Fatalities from health and safety incidents 1.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 报告同页及相邻页明确披露FY25发生1起致命事故，与“everyone can go home safe and well”这一结果性、绝对化表述直接冲突。
notes: 典型安全类绝对化宣传语。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that the organization uses a “safety guarantee” in a way that instils a belief that everyone can go home safe and well (i.e., it effectively drives a safety culture/outcome). No evidence was provided describing what the “safety guarantee” is, that it is implemented, or any factual results (e.g., training/rollout details, participation, safety performance metrics, incident reductions, survey results) showing it instils this belief or improves safety outcomes. As written, the claim is an unverified effectiveness statement.
